name: agentic-playbook-cli
description: Deterministic scanner, scorer, record validator and renderer for the Agentic Playbook plugin.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/agentic.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from "module"; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node dist/agentic.mjs lint-playbook
